name: Ines Harrowgate
role: Holder of the Slip at Keelmouth — keeps the only slipway on four hundred miles of cliff open to anyone who pays the posted tariff
appearance: A tall, salt-greyed woman in a harbour-watch coat with the lining patched in three colours. Works the slip rope herself on busy days.
voiceHints: Plain and warm, with a harbour-master's habit of giving the cost of a thing before the thing. Keeps promises out loud, in front of witnesses.
wants: The Slip open to everyone, at the same price, for as long as there is a Keelmouth.
fears: That she will have to spend her people's lives to keep it that way.
knowledge: Every hull that has gone into the water at Keelmouth in twenty years
How many road-men the Baron at Firstsight can levy, and how many would stay
The tides, the estuary channels and the sea-roads out of the Outrun

reactsToReputation.any: charges you the carved tariff and asks whether you have eaten
reactsToReputation.honest: lends you the harbour watch without being asked twice
reactsToReputation.known-cruel: charges you the tariff and watches you until you leave

questSeeds: The Baron at Firstsight has closed the road to Keelmouth's supply wagons
Keelmouth's families would fight for her, and she is trying not to let them
title: Holder of the Slip
_domainsWhy: a builder's ledger, the sea-roads, and the care that feeds whoever wrecks by accident
